correctness.rationale: For a finite one-agent S5 model, successors of a world are its complete equivalence class. An active cross-model class pair must have identical atomic profile support and, for each profile, the chosen relation pairs form a spanning bipartite edge cover. Conversely any selection of compatible class pairs and independent internal profile covers satisfies atomic harmony, forth and back. This is a genuine bijection (even if a class participates in multiple pairs). Inclusion-exclusion gives U(a,b) spanning covers. Any inclusion-minimal cover has every edge incident to a degree-one endpoint; its connected components are precisely stars, yielding H(a,b) from exp(xy+x(e^y-1-y)+y(e^x-1-x)). Thus nonempty, minimal nonempty, global, and minimal global relations are counted respectively by product_{ij}(1+beta_ij)-1; sum eta_ij; a weighted spanning edge-cover sum on compatibility graph; and a weighted minimal edge-cover sum. These formulas cover empty compatibility graphs, isolated class vertices, zero propositional vocabulary, all nonempty finite labelled models and distinguish inclusion-minimality from minimum size.
residual_risks: The result is one-agent S5 only. Multiagent forth/back constraints do not decouple into these independent class-pair covers.
Finite checks corroborate, but the unrestricted conclusion follows from the structural bijection and minimality proof.

value.rationale: A universal exact census for four natural classes of witnesses between arbitrary fixed finite epistemic models is a useful structural classification, not just another example or arbitrary small enumeration. The layered normal form allows researchers to compute minimal/global witness abundance and understand effects of accessibility partitions and valuations.
residual_risks: Value depends on genuine model-theoretic two-stage assembly rather than the familiar isolated edge-cover identity.

limitations: Counts labelled relations on fixed finite one-agent S5 models only, not automorphism orbits, multiagent models or arbitrary Kripke frames.
Global means both full projections; inclusion-minimal is not synonymous with cardinality-minimum.
